package audit

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	models "example.test/auditapp/internal/models/audit"
	"example.test/auditapp/internal/scope"
)

const watchBatch = 100

// Watch replays audit events after the requested sequence number, then sends
// everything newer each time the client sends a {seq} cursor. The tenant and
// subject come only from the verified Execution; the generated stream closes
// when the gate is revoked.
func Watch(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	p WatchPorts,
	in models.WatchRequest,
	stream scope.Stream[models.Cursor, models.Tick],
) error {
	var next int64

	if in.After != nil {
		next = *in.After
	}

	for {
		if err := replay(ctx, e, p, stream, next); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		cursor, err := stream.Receive(ctx)
		if errors.Is(err, scope.ErrStreamClosed) {
			return nil
		}

		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		next = max(cursor.Seq, 0)
	}
}

func replay(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	p WatchPorts,
	stream scope.Stream[models.Cursor, models.Tick],
	from int64,
) error {
	for {
		batch, err := p.Events.Scan(ctx, e, from, watchBatch)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		for _, entry := range batch {
			if err := stream.Send(ctx, models.Tick{Seq: entry.Seq, Type: entry.Type}); err != nil {
				return err
			}

			from = entry.Seq
		}

		if len(batch) < watchBatch {
			return nil
		}
	}
}
